relationships.subject: Gentisic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings collectively demonstrate that Gentisic acid improves DRG neuronal viability by suppressing M1 macrophage polarization through the MAPK14/S100A9 signaling pathway.

key_findings: Gentisic acid binds MAPK14, lowers S100A9, suppresses M1 macrophage polarization and improves DRG neuron viability and autophagy.
In LDH rats, gentisic acid reduced pain behaviors and DRG TRPV1, with efficacy comparable to Celebrex.
